_comment: verify_webhook (Standard Webhooks). Each case starts from the defaults below and changes what it names: `headers` replaces those headers (null removes one), `header_case` "upper" sends the three names in upper case, `now` is the clock in Unix seconds, `tolerance` the allowed clock skew in seconds (default 300). The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over "<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<body>", keyed by the base64-decoded secret after the whsec_ prefix (its bytes when that is not base64), sent base64-encoded as "v1,<sig>". valid: whether verification passes; type: the parsed event's type when it does.
body: {"id":"msg_2nY8kTestVector01","type":"monitor.result.found","created_at":"2026-11-17T17:20:00Z","data":{"monitor_id":"mon_test01","result":{"url":"https://example.com/news/1","title":"Open weights model released","author":null,"published_at":"2026-11-17T16:00:00Z","acquired_at":"2026-11-17T16:05:00Z","image":null,"matched_at":"2026-11-17T16:10:00Z","published_at_source":"declared","summary":"A lab released an open-weights model.","importance":4,"kind":"news","source_type":"original"}},"metadata":{"team":"research"}}

cases.name: a valid signature
the timestamp 300 s ago is within the default tolerance
the timestamp 300 s ahead is within the default tolerance
the timestamp 301 s ago is refused
the timestamp 301 s ahead is refused
a wider tolerance takes an older timestamp
one of several signatures matches
a signature of another version is not read
a wrong signature
a signature without its version
a changed body

cases.name: a changed webhook-id
a missing webhook-id
a missing webhook-timestamp
a missing webhook-signature
a timestamp that is not a number
a 400-digit timestamp is refused
a 13-digit timestamp is refused even when its value is now and it is signed
header names in any case
a secret without the whsec_ prefix
a secret that is not base64 is used as its bytes
a secret of only whsec_ has no key and is refused, even signed with the empty key
a signed body that is not JSON is refused
a signed JSON body that is not an object is refused
